primary_endpoint: Relative change from baseline in liver fat content by MRI-PDFF, baseline to approximately Day 95.
efficacy_outcome: Relative liver fat change: -50.28% with miricorilant 900 mg, -22.94% with 600 mg, and +4.63% with placebo; no statistical comparison reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 2/3 participants receiving 900 mg, 0/5 receiving 600 mg, and 0/4 receiving placebo; no deaths.
